sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, for 77 minutes, amid intense scrutiny of his leadership and connections to Russia,
sentences.zh: 今天，在对其领导能力及其与俄罗斯关系的严密审查中，特朗普总统进行了长达77分钟的发言，

sentences.en: President Trump turns the scrutiny back on the news media, attacking its credibility and its judgment during a remarkable news conference.
sentences.zh: 他在一场引人注目的新闻发布会上，将矛头反转指向新闻媒体，攻击其公信力和判断力。

sentences.en: And the view from Russia why the government of Vladimir Putin may relish all of this attention, no matter how good or bad.

sentences.en: It's Friday, February 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月17日，星期五。

sentences.en: I turn on the TV, open the newspapers, and I see stories of chaos.
sentences.zh: 我打开电视，翻开报纸，看到的都是混乱的报道。

sentences.en: Chaos.
sentences.zh: 混乱。

sentences.en: Yet it is the exact opposite.
sentences.zh: 然而事实恰恰相反。

sentences.en: This administration
sentences.zh: 这届政府

sentences.en: is running like a fine-tuned machine.
sentences.zh: 运转得像一台精密调校的机器。

sentences.en: In these stories,
sentences.zh: 在这些报道中，

sentences.en: Trump sees a version of his presidency that he does not like.
sentences.zh: 特朗普看到了一个他不喜欢的总统任期版本。

sentences.en: I mean, it's story after story after story is bad.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，报道一篇接一篇，全都是负面的。

sentences.en: This week, it's the story of his national security advisor, retired Lieutenant General Michael Flynn.
sentences.zh: 本周，焦点是关于他的国家安全顾问、退役中将迈克尔·弗林的报道。

sentences.en: He was forced to resign after reports that he misled Vice President Mike Pence about a phone call with the Russian ambassador to the United States.
sentences.zh: 在有报道称他误导了副总统迈克·彭斯，隐瞒了与俄罗斯驻美大使通话的内容后，他被迫辞职。

sentences.en: The press has become
sentences.zh: 媒体已经变得

sentences.en: so dishonest that if we don't talk about it, we are doing a tremendous
sentences.zh: 如此不诚实，如果我们不谈论这一点，我们就是对美国人民

sentences.en: disservice to the American people.
sentences.zh: 造成了巨大的伤害。

sentences.en: Tremendous disservice.
sentences.zh: 巨大的伤害。

sentences.en: We have to talk about it to find out what's going on because the press honestly is out of control.
sentences.zh: 我们必须谈论它，找出到底发生了什么，因为说实话，媒体已经失控了。

sentences.en: The level of dishonesty is out of control.
sentences.zh: 这种不诚实的程度已经失控了。

sentences.en: That view of the press brings us and the rest of the media to the White House on Thursday afternoon where President Trump is standing behind a podium in the East Room.
sentences.zh: 那种对媒体的看法，将我们和其他媒体带到了周四下午的白宫，特朗普总统正站在东厅的讲台后。

sentences.en: This press conference was hastily called.
sentences.zh: 这场新闻发布会召开得非常仓促。

sentences.en: There was an hour's notice at least in terms of when the cable networks broke in to say they were going to do this.
sentences.zh: 至少在有线电视网插播预告说要直播这场发布会时，只提前了一个小时通知。

sentences.en: Jim Rutenberg is the media columnist at the Times and a former political reporter.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·鲁滕伯格是《时报》的媒体专栏作家，也是一名前政治记者。

sentences.en: This was roadblocked across the networks at least every time I checked.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，各大电视网几乎都进行了全程阻断式直播。

sentences.en: Every major network was showing this and that's a big deal especially during the day.
sentences.zh: 每家主流电视网都在播放这个，这可是件大事，尤其是在白天。

sentences.en: These are millions of Americans are home with the television on watching soaps, watching Ellen, watching what have you.
sentences.zh: 当时有数百万美国人在家开着电视，看着肥皂剧，看着《艾伦秀》，或者做着其他什么事。

sentences.en: This broke in and he is talking to his people.
sentences.zh: 节目被中断了，而他正在向他的人民喊话。

sentences.en: So the listeners now have like a mental definition that they can use.
sentences.zh: 所以听众现在有了一个可以使用的心理定义。

sentences.en: Roadblocking.
sentences.zh: 阻断式直播。

sentences.en: What is it?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: Roadblocking is when the major broadcast networks that still deliver more viewers than cable combined, way more, just across the board give the president their air.
sentences.zh: 阻断式直播是指那些观众人数仍远超有线电视总和的主流广播电视网，全面地将播出时间交给总统。

sentences.en: So it's the most powerful thing in any president's arsenal even now in the age of the internet.
sentences.zh: 所以，即使在互联网时代，这也是任何总统武器库中最强大的工具。

sentences.en: So why call this press conference?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么要召开这场新闻发布会呢？

sentences.en: Why use this power at this precise moment?
sentences.zh: 为什么要在这个特定的时刻动用这种权力？

sentences.en: So the news is sort of winning in Donald Trump's mind, right?
sentences.zh: 在唐纳德·特朗普看来，新闻界似乎正在获胜，对吧？

sentences.en: It's breaking through.
sentences.zh: 它正在取得突破。

sentences.en: All the accusations heretofore about fake news cannot stop the inexorable reality that his national security advisor had to resign under pressure.
sentences.zh: 此前所有关于“假新闻”的指控，都无法阻止一个不可逆转的事实：他的国家安全顾问被迫辞职了。

sentences.en: It wasn't the news media by the way that made that happen.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，促成这件事的并不是新闻媒体。

sentences.en: It was the news media that reported it aggressively.
sentences.zh: 是新闻媒体进行了积极的报道。

sentences.en: It got out.
sentences.zh: 消息传开了。

sentences.en: So in my view, he decides
sentences.zh: 所以在我看来，他决定

sentences.en: I'm going to have a giant press conference regain the leverage, school them, turn up to 11, the volume on the fake news allegations and use them as props because he knows
sentences.zh: 我要召开一场大型新闻发布会，夺回主动权，教训他们，把对“假新闻”的指控音量调到最大，并把他们当作道具，因为他知道

sentences.en: they're stuck there sitting in front of him to be schooled.
sentences.zh: 他们正被困在那里，坐在他面前等着被教训。

sentences.en: But Flynn's resignation, that's the first place that reporters in the room go when Trump opens up for questions.
sentences.zh: 但弗林的辞职，是特朗普开放提问时，在场记者最先关注的问题。

sentences.en: They want to know what happened.
sentences.zh: 他们想知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: Did you fire Mike Flynn?
sentences.zh: 你解雇迈克·弗林了吗？

sentences.en: Mike Flynn is a fine person and I asked for his resignation.
sentences.zh: 迈克·弗林是个好人，我要求他辞职。

sentences.en: He respectfully gave it.
sentences.zh: 他恭敬地照做了。

sentences.en: What he did wasn't wrong.
sentences.zh: 他所做的事情并没有错。

sentences.en: What was wrong was the way that other people including yourselves in this room were given that information because that was classified information and was given illegally.
sentences.zh: 错的是其他人，包括你们在座的各位，获取信息的方式，因为那是机密信息，而且获取途径是非法的。

sentences.en: That's the real problem.
sentences.zh: 那才是真正的问题所在。

sentences.en: I'm really struck by that language that he doesn't think that Michael Flynn did something wrong.
sentences.zh: 他认为迈克尔·弗林没有做错任何事，这种言论让我感到非常震惊。

sentences.en: What do we make of the fact that Donald Trump thinks that it's okay to have done what Michael Flynn did?
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普认为迈克尔·弗林所做的事情是可以接受的，我们该如何解读这一点？

sentences.en: I think he's always played by his own rules.
sentences.zh: 我认为他一直都是按自己的规则行事。

sentences.en: President Trump and he's always sort of really gotten away with it.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统，而且他似乎总是能侥幸逃脱。

sentences.en: He's won.
sentences.zh: 他赢了。

sentences.en: He won the election playing by his own rules.
sentences.zh: 他按自己的规则赢得了选举。

sentences.en: This really was the first time he had to kind of give in to the way things work in Washington.
sentences.zh: 这确实是他第一次不得不向华盛顿的行事方式妥协。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: His guy's in trouble.
sentences.zh: 他的人出事了。

sentences.en: He had to cut them loose and it's a loss which again I think is why he wanted to have this press conference to regain in his mind the upper hand against what he is calling

sentences.zh: 他和一位CNN记者之间有一段对话，

sentences.en: I just see many many untruthful things and I'll tell you what else I see.

sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我真的不是个坏人。

sentences.zh: 不，但那种基调……我确实有很好的收视率，你必须承认，那种基调充满了仇恨。

sentences.zh: 当他谈到“基调”时，你是否有一种似曾相识的冲击感？不是针对这里或任何特定机构，而是泛指媒体、这位总统以及当下这个时刻？

sentences.en: There is a tone out there it does get quite
sentences.zh: 确实存在一种基调，它确实变得相当……

sentences.en: you watch CNN sometimes and all the networks except for Fox and you can notice it's like people are lighting their hair on fire behind these desks.
sentences.zh: 你有时看CNN和除了福克斯以外的所有电视网，你会注意到，就像人们在主播台后火烧眉毛一样。

sentences.en: That said you know there's a counter argument that these are extraordinary times and they're reacting to him.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，有一种反驳观点认为，这是非常时期，他们是在对他做出反应。

sentences.en: It's so important to the public to get an honest press.

sentences.zh: 他在承认——你认为他在承认——他发挥了作用，他在说：我相信我可能在削弱美国媒体方面发挥了作用。

sentences.zh: 你认为他为什么现在要承认这一点？

sentences.en: First of all he's put a lot of work into it so he's probably proud of that accomplishment.
sentences.zh: 首先，他在这上面投入了大量精力，所以他可能为这一成就感到自豪。

sentences.en: Oh that's a fascinating observation.
sentences.zh: 哦，那是一个迷人的观察。

sentences.en: It's been a talking point of his throughout the campaign and then by the way he put so much work into it for moments like this.
sentences.zh: 这在整个竞选过程中一直是他的谈资，而且顺便说一句，他为这样的时刻投入了太多精力。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: When he's in this is this is inarguably a crisis moment for any White House.

sentences.en: So this is a time when you say don't believe what you're hearing on the news.

sentences.en: Well the leaks are real.

sentences.en: You're the one that wrote about them and reported them.
sentences.zh: 是你写了关于它们的文章并报道了它们。

sentences.zh: 所以有一件事我觉得非常重要，我希望我们能纠正它，因为没有人比记者——好吧，也许稍微有一点——比优秀的记者更值得我尊重。

sentences.en: than good reporters.
sentences.zh: 比优秀的记者。

sentences.en: It's very important to me and especially in this position.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说非常重要，尤其是在这个职位上。

sentences.en: I mean come on it's just directly contradictory.

sentences.en: I think I know what he's doing and what he's doing is on the one hand saying the deep state you know he's playing to this kind of conspiracy theory kicking around the deep state

sentences.en: the deep state's out to get me so this stuff is real.
sentences.zh: “深层政府”要对付我，所以这些东西是真的。

sentences.en: This is the idea of the intelligence community being kind of a permanent fixture in American government with access to all these secrets.

sentences.en: Yeah the establishment fighting back you know with some
